# Listen along & radio chat (HTTP)

Listen along and radio chat run as Cloudflare Workers, separate from the main API. Most of their functionality uses WebSockets. See the WebSocket documents in the document selector.

This document covers their read-only HTTP endpoints.

Base URL: https://listen-along.neurokaraoke.com (Listen along worker.), https://radio-chat.neurokaraoke.com (Radio chat worker.)

## Listen along

Shared listening rooms with a synchronized playback queue.

### `GET /rooms/public` — List public rooms

Host: https://listen-along.neurokaraoke.com

Auth: none

Returns all open public rooms, ordered by listener count (descending), then creation time. Rooms with no updates for one hour are removed automatically.

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  roomId?: string  // Value to pass as `roomId` when connecting to the WebSocket.
  roomName?: string
  inviteCode?: string
  isPublic?: bool
  allowListenerAddSongs?: bool
  allowListenerSongCommands?: bool
  allowDuplicateSongs?: bool
  listenerAddSongCooldownSeconds?: int
  autoRemovePlayedSongs?: bool
  hostUserId?: string
  hostDisplayName?: string
  hostAvatarUrl?: string | null
  listenerCount?: int
  maxListeners?: int
  nowPlaying?: {
    queueItemId?: string
    songId?: string
    title?: string
    artists?: string
    audioUrl?: string
    hlsUrl?: string | null
    coverUrl?: string
    positionSeconds?: number
    durationSeconds?: number
    isPlaying?: bool
    serverTimestampMs?: int  // Server time (Unix ms) when the snapshot was taken. Add the elapsed time to `positionSeconds` to get the current position.
  } | null
  createdAt?: date-time
}[]
```

### `GET /rooms/mine` — List rooms hosted by a user

Host: https://listen-along.neurokaraoke.com

Auth: none

Returns all rooms, public and private, hosted by the user given in `userId`. Returns an empty array when `userId` is missing.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |

### `GET /rooms/info` — Look up a room by invite code

Host: https://listen-along.neurokaraoke.com

Auth: none

Returns room details for an invite code. Used to generate link previews for invite URLs.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | query | `string` | yes | Invite code from the room link. |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  roomId?: string  // Value to pass as `roomId` when connecting to the WebSocket.
  roomName?: string
  inviteCode?: string
  isPublic?: bool
  allowListenerAddSongs?: bool
  allowListenerSongCommands?: bool
  allowDuplicateSongs?: bool
  listenerAddSongCooldownSeconds?: int
  autoRemovePlayedSongs?: bool
  hostUserId?: string
  hostDisplayName?: string
  hostAvatarUrl?: string | null
  listenerCount?: int
  maxListeners?: int
  nowPlaying?: {
    queueItemId?: string
    songId?: string
    title?: string
    artists?: string
    audioUrl?: string
    hlsUrl?: string | null
    coverUrl?: string
    positionSeconds?: number
    durationSeconds?: number
    isPlaying?: bool
    serverTimestampMs?: int  // Server time (Unix ms) when the snapshot was taken. Add the elapsed time to `positionSeconds` to get the current position.
  } | null
  createdAt?: date-time
}
```

Response `400` The `code` parameter is missing.

Response `404` No open room matches the invite code.

## Radio chat

Chat for the 24/7 radio stream.

### `GET /nowplaying` — Get the radio's current song

Host: https://radio-chat.neurokaraoke.com

Auth: none

Returns the song currently playing on the radio and upcoming songs.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lang` | query | `string` | no | Language room to query. All rooms report the same stream.; Possible values: `en`, `ja`, `zh`; default: "en" |

Response `200` OK. Returns an empty object if no now-playing data has been received yet. `application/json`:

```ts
{ [key: string]: any }
```
